name: Reiko Kujo
want: leave the school better than she found it, and choose a worthy successor
secret: She has secretly applied to an art college in Tokyo to become a manga artist instead of the law faculty her parents chose, and draws a shoujo manga at night.
voice: Cool, precise, never raises her voice; a rare small smile is an event.
description: Runs the student council like a ministry. Feared and admired; first-years bow when she passes.
appearance: Long straight hair, a black hairband, the council armband, ink on the side of her right hand.

agenda.goal: choose a worthy successor before the November election
steps: watches Kazuha Minase and Ren Takamura run the club budget meeting

steps.text: asks the player, of all people, what they think the school needs

steps: tells Kazuha she should run for president
